processDefinition.name: transaction_aml_check
processDefinition.description: 交易反洗钱检查DAG：扫描transaction_monitor监控命中记录，匹配AML规则，写入aml_alert与risk_alert告警表

taskDefinitionList.name: extract_transaction_monitor
taskDefinitionList.description: 抽取近30分钟transaction_monitor命中记录到临时表tmp_aml_monitor_src

taskParams.sql: INSERT INTO ${db_finance}.tmp_aml_monitor_src SELECT monitor_id, transaction_id, customer_id, rule_id, hit_score, checked_at FROM ${db_finance}.transaction_monitor WHERE checked_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 MINUTE) AND alert_status = 'HIT';

taskDefinitionList.name: match_aml_rules
taskDefinitionList.description: 匹配AML规则：大额交易/频繁交易/拆分交易/跨境交易等，关联transaction_detail获取明细

taskParams.sql: INSERT INTO ${db_finance}.tmp_aml_alert_candidate SELECT m.monitor_id, m.transaction_id, m.customer_id, m.rule_id, m.hit_score, t.amount, t.currency, t.counterparty_account, t.counterparty_bank, CASE WHEN t.amount >= 50000 THEN 'LARGE_AMOUNT' WHEN t.cross_border_flag = 'Y' THEN 'CROSS_BORDER' ELSE 'SUSPICIOUS_PATTERN' END AS aml_rule_type, NOW() AS detected_at FROM ${db_finance}.tmp_aml_monitor_src m JOIN ${db_finance}.transaction t ON m.transaction_id = t.transaction_id WHERE t.amount >= 20000 OR t.cross_border_flag = 'Y';

taskDefinitionList.name: load_aml_alert
taskDefinitionList.description: 将AML告警写入aml_alert表，含可疑交易报告STR信息

taskParams.sql: INSERT INTO ${db_finance}.aml_alert (alert_id, transaction_id, customer_id, alert_type, risk_level, alert_status, detected_at, report_deadline, str_flag, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) SELECT CONCAT('AML', DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s'), LPAD(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(), 6, '0')) AS alert_id, transaction_id, customer_id, aml_rule_type AS alert_type, CASE WHEN hit_score >= 80 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN hit_score >= 50 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS risk_level, 'OPEN' AS alert_status, detected_at, DATE_ADD(detected_at, INTERVAL 3 DAY) AS report_deadline, CASE WHEN hit_score >= 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS str_flag, NOW(), NOW(), 'dag_transaction_aml_check', 'dag_transaction_aml_check' FROM ${db_finance}.tmp_aml_alert_candidate;

taskDefinitionList.name: load_risk_alert
taskDefinitionList.description: 同步AML告警到risk_alert表，触发风控评估流程

taskParams.sql: INSERT INTO ${db_finance}.risk_alert (alert_id, eval_id, rule_id, alert_type, alert_level, alert_status, alert_at, handle_deadline, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) SELECT CONCAT('RKA', alert_id) AS alert_id, NULL AS eval_id, rule_id, 'AML' AS alert_type, risk_level AS alert_level, 'OPEN' AS alert_status, detected_at AS alert_at, DATE_ADD(detected_at, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS handle_deadline, NOW(), NOW(), 'dag_transaction_aml_check', 'dag_transaction_aml_check' FROM ${db_finance}.aml_alert WHERE detected_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 MINUTE) AND created_by = 'dag_transaction_aml_check';

taskDefinitionList.name: notify_aml_alert
taskDefinitionList.description: 通知AML告警生成，高风险告警实时飞书告警

emailConfig.subject: [DAG-AML告警]transaction_aml_check-${biz_date}
emailConfig.content: 交易反洗钱检查已完成，业务日期：${biz_date}，已生成aml_alert与risk_alert告警，请及时处理高风险告警。
